record_type_quote: In a follow-up study we replicated the self-affirmation intervention in a later semester of the same course, with the same instructor.

targets.evidence_quote: The results of our initial study to test the impact of a self-affirmation exercise on the gender gap in Physics 1 were reported earlier [7,8].
targets.outcome_quote: In this paper, we report the details and preliminary results of the replication study, where we find similar patterns along exams and course grades, but do not observe these patterns along the FMCE.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors describe matching exam patterns but nonreplication of FMCE patterns.
